title: The Effect of Capital Gains Taxes on Business Creation and Employment: The Case of Opportunity Zones
eligible_reason: Single adoption date. All Opportunity Zone tracts were designated in 2018, so Designated is time-invariant and the design is Designated x year on a biennial tract panel (2017 pre; 2019, 2021 post). The csdid call (2_1_main_tables.do lines 226-227) sets g_csdid = 2019 for every designated tract (one cohort; 1_7_extend2018.do uses 2018), so Callaway-Sant'Anna collapses to a two-group DiD. Most specifications are pooled OLS or quantile regressions with ACS controls and a lagged growth outcome rather than TWFE. Fails the at-least-two-adoption-dates rule.
design_notes: Tract-year panel of OZ-eligible Census tracts (final data/dta_tract_allTo2021_DiD.dta, 171 MB, now fully present), odd years, analysis years 2017/2019/2021, state != 72. Table 2: reg emp_growth Designated##i.year [$cov emp_growth15], plus qreg, winsorized outcomes, aweights, xtreg fe by fips/cbsa. Table 7: csdid emp_growth_w010 $cov emp_growth13 emp_growth15 emp_growth17, ivar(fips) time(year) gvar(g_csdid) drimp with g_csdid in {0, 2019}; IPW-weighted event studies (Freedman et al. 2023). Table 9: contiguity-ring spillovers. LODES analysis in 2_3_lodes_analysis.do. Covariates: cov_acs_pct_white cov_acs_pct_higher_ed cov_acs_pct_rent cov_acs_pct_native_hc_covered cov_acs_pct_poverty cov_acs_log_median_earnings cov_acs_log_median_hh_income cov_acs_total_housing cov_acs_log_median_gross_rent cov_acs_pct_supplemental_income cov_acs_pct_employed cov_acs_minutes_commute.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One cohort: OZ designation in 2018 for all Designated==1 tracts (g_csdid==2019 for all treated).

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date; pooled OLS without unit FE in base column; later columns add time-varying ACS controls and lagged outcome
specs.treatment_definition: Designated = tract designated as an Opportunity Zone in 2018 (time-invariant)

specs.exclusion_reason: single cohort (g_csdid = 2019 for all treated); conditional on time-varying covariates and lagged outcomes
specs.fe: csdid drimp with $cov emp_growth13 emp_growth15 emp_growth17
specs.sample_condition: Low-Income Community tracts, years 2017/2019/2021; cbsa_status==1 subsample

data_provenance: synthetic/perturbed: readme.tex (line 169) states the shipped analysis files are 'exemplary data' with errors infused into all YTS-derived variables, so results differ from the paper; raw YTS/Data Axle data are licensed (WRDS)
software_notes: Stata (reg, qreg, xtreg, csdid, outreg2, putexcel); Julia for Census API and distances; R for contiguity; Python for party data.
screener_notes: Supersedes _stale_mnsc.2022.03223.json: the 1.6 GB archive is now fully extracted (141 files, all data present), which changes data_files_present to true, but the data are explicitly error-infused (data_access synthetic) and the design is still a single 2018 cohort. Screened from package only.
